requirements.text: Joining and leaving a room emits one join and one leave per user, even with several tabs
Connections that stop heartbeating expire after a TTL and emit leave
Subscribers receive a snapshot and then ordered join/update/leave events pushed over a persistent connection
The transport is a WebSocket that authenticates the upgrade and checks Origin
Rooms are tenant-scoped, joining requires authorization, and only the joining actor can heartbeat or leave its connection
Presence state is size-limited JSON, updates are throttled, and rooms have a capacity
Presence is consistent across several server instances (shared store and pub/sub)

evidence.name: several tabs of one user appear once
SSE stream: joins, sends a snapshot then ordered events
rooms are tenant scoped and authorization is enforced
a connection can be heartbeated or left only by the actor who joined it
state must be JSON within maxStateBytes
update events are coalesced per user
maxPerRoom refuses new connections with room-full

implementations.notes: Pushes over Server-Sent Events with HTTP heartbeats, not WebSockets; the memory store is per process and the Redis shape is documented only
